# Publish

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core plugin that allows you to host your notes online as a website, wiki, or documentation.

## Scope note

- Enables sharing of Obsidian notes to a wider audience.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
